Must have previous experience in commercial ballast retrofit.
Five years building maintenance experience.

1-3 yearsof experience performing general building maintenance and repairs, including carpentry, painting, flooring, ceiling systems, and other structural repairs in a commercial or institutional setting.

Performs general maintenance and repairs in assigned buildings including window blinds, window screens, projection screens and window glass. Also repairs stair treads and installs soap, towel, and toilet paper dispensers, hangs chalkboards, whiteboards and bulletin boards. Replaces sheet-rock paneling and repairs plaster walls including preparation and painting. Repairs ceilings, sub-floors, ceramic tiles and vinyl tiles. Replaces lights and ballasts. Repairs and/or replaces damaged interior concrete. Assists with the repairs to various roofing systems and performs other routine maintenance duties. Incumbent is required to communicate with academic building managers daily. Works effectively as a ?Team Member? by using positive communication techniques, bringing talent to the team, and supporting teammates by fulfilling responsibilities, helping teammates when called upon, and contributing to the overall success of the team.
Must be able to cut and replace window glass.

Must be able to apply paints and finishes.

Must be able to repair/replace bathroom fixtures including partitions, soap dispensers, and toilet seats.

Ability to read blueprints and drawings.

Must have ability to repair/replace floor tile and carpet, and cove base.
